appearance_facts.fact: A single solid teal line connects yearly points from 2012 to 2023.
The vertical axis is labeled 'Telehealth follow-up requests' with gridlines at 0, 600, 1200, 1800, 2400, and 3000.
The horizontal axis is labeled 'Year' with ticks from 2012 through 2023.
The title reads 'Declining Telehealth Follow-up Requests from 2012 to 203' and the subtitle reads 'Program demand record shown in the dashboard summary'.
The line starts near the lower-left, rises with small dips, climbs steeply after 2020, peaks near 2022, and then steps down at 2023.

uncertain: The chart title says 'Declining', but the plotted line shows a long upward trend from 2012 to 2022 with only a small drop at 2023; it is unclear whether the title is a label or a misstatement.
There is no legend, so the single teal line is assumed to be the only series, but no explicit series name is printed.
